node.title: XR profile minor-certificate coverage
node.statement: For every budget-meeting unpaid non-boundary light-triangle profile, produce a maximal minor of the normal-form matrix from xr_triangle_eliminant_form and an admissible chart specialization at which that determinant is nonzero. This is reduced to the proved triangular-minor soundness criterion, the record-inventory soundness rule, and the remaining actual uniform profile record inventory payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the triangular determinant criterion, record-inventory soundness, and the remaining uniform profile inventory payload; toy E32 data remains evidence only
node.falsifier: a budget-meeting unpaid non-boundary light profile for which every maximal minor vanishes at every admissible specialization
